orderProjectLead: Ready to start your project? Read about the collaboration process, required information, and how to submit your request.

step1.title: Submit Request
step1.desc: Fill out the form below with initial project details including type, description, budget, and timeline.

step2.title: Review & Analysis
step2.desc: Your project will be reviewed. If needed, an online or phone meeting will be scheduled to clarify details.

step3.title: Proposal
step3.desc: After analysis, a formal proposal including cost, timeline, technologies, and delivery phases will be provided.

step4.title: Agreement & Contract
step4.desc: Once terms are agreed upon, a formal contract is signed and the deposit is received.

step5.title: Design & Development
step5.desc: UI/UX design, frontend and backend development, and feature implementation according to the schedule.

step6.title: Testing & Feedback
step6.desc: The initial version is provided for testing and necessary feedback is applied.

step7.title: Final Delivery
step7.desc: After final approval, the project is delivered and necessary training is provided.

step8.title: Support
step8.desc: Technical support and bug-fix period begins as per the contract.

requiredInfo.title: Required Information for Project Order
requiredInfo.desc: For accurate review and appropriate proposal, please specify the following when submitting your request:

items.label: Project Goal
items.detail: What problem are you solving? What value do you create for users?

items.label: Target Audience
items.detail: Who are your users? (age, occupation, interests, expertise level)

items.label: Core Features
items.detail: What features are essential? What features are second priority?

items.label: Design & Brand
items.detail: Do you have a logo, brand colors, or visual style guide?

items.label: Similar Examples
items.detail: Which websites or apps do you like? What elements do you prefer?

items.label: Estimated Budget
items.detail: What is your budget range? (low, medium, high)

items.label: Timeline
items.detail: When do you expect delivery? Is there a specific deadline?

items.label: Languages
items.detail: Is the project monolingual or multilingual? Which languages are needed?

items.label: Infrastructure
items.detail: Do you have hosting and domain? Do you need setup?

items.label: Growth & Marketing
items.detail: Do you need SEO, content production, or advertising campaigns?
